trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops by itself once the other 54 are done, so there is nothing to do for this one directly. Treat it as the finish line, not a task: no online play or DLC is needed, and every one of the 54 is single-player and offline. When the last of them pops, this one follows.
trophies.source2: eGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies And Achievements

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Pure story, impossible to miss. It pops when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1. There is nothing extra to do and no way to skip past it, so just play.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops as Chapter 1 ends — PowerPyx notes it lands after the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, so just keep playing the story and it arrives on its own.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops as Chapter 2 ends — PowerPyx notes it lands after the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City. Nothing to do but play the story through.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops as Chapter 3 ends — PowerPyx notes it lands after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Just keep playing.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops as Chapter 4 ends — PowerPyx notes it lands after the final main mission of the chapter, Starting From Zero. Finish the chapter and it is yours.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story gold for finishing the final mission — PowerPyx places it at the end of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero. Play the story to the end and this pops with it. The Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory has its own trophy, Snow Storm, so do not confuse the two.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. Just play through the mission and it unlocks on its own.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Just play through the mission and it unlocks on its own.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Just play through the mission and it unlocks on its own.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Just play through the mission and it unlocks on its own.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. Just play through the mission and it unlocks on its own.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory, the last of the mission trophies. Just play through the mission and it unlocks on its own.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The big one: reach 100% completion. After the story the checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress you made during the story already counts. PowerPyx stresses it is not true 100% — it is closer to 60% of the game's content, with forgiving thresholds: 100 optional missions, 300 of 397 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 meditations, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 Cocaine Flamingos, all 39 gang operations, all 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, all 42 shooting range golds, all 14 drone race locations, all 15 of Bret's Target Decks, and any 70 of the 80 challenges. Nothing on the list is missable, and everything can be done in free-roam after the story. See the roadmap's 100% checklist box for the full list.
trophies.source2: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the game's 397 stunts. PowerPyx breaks them into four kinds — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — and you can mix them however you like; the under-the-bridges runs are the quickest to rack up. Track them under Progress > Activities > Stunts (R3 shows progress by region) or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so this trophy lands on the way there.
trophies.source2: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once. PowerPyx lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad > Progress > Activities, and find them on the map with the Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon). You will almost certainly tick every one off naturally while chasing the other trophies, so do not hunt this one specially.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 shooting range challenges, spread across 12 shooting range locations. PowerPyx links a full location guide; the golds are not too hard, and they also feed your Focus level, which helps the Gunslinger trophy. Work through the ranges one by one — the game tracks golds per challenge, so you can see exactly which ones are left.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 races in total across them). PowerPyx has a location guide for all 14. You only need one win per location, not every race at each spot — and the wins also count toward the 100% checklist, which wants all 14 locations done.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations in the game, so there is plenty of choice — pick the short ones and the ones you enjoy, and skip the rest. Any race win counts as long as it is a different race from the ones you have already won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you a fishing spot west of Key Lento (purple map icon). Go there and take him on — win the challenge and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. The game has four Video Games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1 (use the controllers); the fourth is on arcade machines around the world. Complete means finishing all of a game's levels at least once — you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever game you like best.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline — Lucia only. It opens automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. The line is five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. Everything stays available after the story, so there is no rush.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It opens automatically in Chapter 1 — after the mission Island Dreams, Kenton calls and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure: 7 shipwrecks in total, marked with purple chest icons, using the metal detector on the ocean floor. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2–3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian in Chapter 2 speeds it up), and everything is still there after the story.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline. It opens automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All still available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Careful: not every side questline counts — PowerPyx confirms Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this one. The confirmed counting strands are Kirk (Skunk Ape: Skunk Apeology 101, Search for Tree Effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm: Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago (street racing: Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch, The Last Mile: Backseat Pilot, Pete's Deliveries, Deliver Packages). PowerPyx notes more counting strangers may still be found — any 8 strands will do. Track your count in the trophy list itself.
trophies.source2: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline: deliver all 16 sports cars on Randy's Wish List. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner — that first car is delivered as part of the story. For the rest, scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list, steal it, and drive it to Randy's garage (green RK icon, west Vice City); a car delivered in good condition pays more. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. The full list is Zorrusso, Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D. They turn up most often in east Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline — Jason only. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers for Synthetic Labs appear in Vice City. Go to the labs and destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter; once enough labs are down, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This (shut down the labs), which pops the trophy. Everything is still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots at 10 locations, and each spot counts twice if you meditate there as both Jason and Lucia. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: the first meditation happens in Chapter 1 at Jason's house — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony when she says she is going to meditate, and choose Accept. It is gone for good after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx says it is still unconfirmed whether it is actually required for the trophy — do it anyway to be safe. The last meditation only unlocks once you can play both characters together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. For the 100% checklist you only need 15 of 18, so the checklist is safe either way.
trophies.source2: CryptoGames — GTA 6 100% Completion: Thresholds and the Missable Trophy

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's line opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: playing as Jason, you get a text marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County (Lucia cannot get the message — Jason only). Do that quest and Bret starts marking hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. He gives you the unique rifle Killtelligence SM-69 in the first quest — it lives in any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. Clean one-shot kills pay more but are not required. Track the 15 Target Decks under Map > Activities — all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy should come naturally. Honest caveat: PowerPyx says it is still unconfirmed exactly which animal pops this trophy, so work through Bret's decks and it will come.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in the game (480 cards in total); you need any 3 full sets for the trophy, and 15 full sets for the 100% checklist. PowerPyx has a guide to all 18 set locations — pick the sets whose cards are closest together and finish those first.
trophies.source2: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. These are scannable objects in the world — hold Up and R1 to scan them. PowerPyx counts 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures (plus No Flusher tags), far more than 100 in total, so scan whatever you pass. It all counts toward the 100% checklist too.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, and you only need 50 for this trophy (70 for the 100% checklist, so it pops on the way). Track them under Progress > Challenges. Most will complete themselves while you chase other trophies; save this for late, then pick the easiest ones left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. You can only do this after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner with hold Right + Triangle. Build 4 stars by causing carnage, then escape: a fast sports bike cutting through traffic works, and PowerPyx's easy route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. It also comes automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since the big bank vault robberies always trigger 4 stars — so you may get it without trying.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Only possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break — call your partner (hold Right + Triangle), then hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) while staying chased the whole time. Keep the flashing red/blue wanted level, not the solid red heat level. Gear up first: armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix/Adrenaline for healing. PowerPyx's best spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs): rob a couple of items in each, get into the back room and crack the safe with sticky bombs. If you leave the first store before the police arrive, you may need a 4th shop — and the pop is delayed about half a minute after you leave the third shop, so do not panic.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game has 557 vehicles at launch. The fast way: open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you never have to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this pops on the way. Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming — time slows and weak spots light up, draining the purple focus bar under your health. Buff focus first with food, drinks, or a wash/shower at home, and pop Adrenaline (hold L1, then Triangle) to stretch the slow-mo. Then line up 5 enemies — PowerPyx suggests the criminals at gang operations — and drop them fast without missing; an assault rifle like the Duke 556 helps. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus); raise it via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, and by the time you are deep into the game you will likely be at level 4 and may earn this naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal one of the big passenger planes docked at a departure terminal — it must be connected to a boarding bridge, not one sitting on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, and the stairs next to the boarding bridge lead straight into the plane (or walk in through the terminal). Go upstairs, get in the cockpit, reverse the plane to the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the pop is a little delayed, so keep flying.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The tanks sit in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive in through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — that unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons on unfogged map areas. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun (it stays in your inventory; when you reach a locked door you choose between kicking it, which sounds the alarm, and the Snap Gun). Inside, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm in the back room. The trophy pops shortly after you leave. PowerPyx's suggested spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) — it introduces vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, wait for the guard to carry the briefcase in and the vault to open, then go in and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash alone, so bring your partner and hold Right to hand off a bag. After that, pay Yasmani for security-van tips ($10,000 a tip; do his earlier quests first, including 2 Payday Loan robberies) and follow the purple van icons to more banks. Every vault robbery triggers an instant 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to shake the heat. There are 8 large bank jobs in total; you need 5 for the trophy and all 8 for the 100% checklist, and a single vault can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the same Chapter 4 mission, That's Where The Money Is…: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing the truck — then escape the red heat radius or use a Pay 'n' Spray. Want it earlier? Armored trucks also drive around Vice City near banks: block one's path, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests), then escape the heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the entire map is visible. PowerPyx has a guide to the best plane for unfogging.
trophies.source2: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements: the full official list

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 gang operations in total; you only need one per gang for this trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39, so it pops on the way. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically as the story goes on. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar — the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Hack into the car, drive forward through the glass, and keep driving — the pop is slightly delayed. Only this blue Banshee works; it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. It opens as the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation first: you need them to blow the safe. The three valuables are a luxury watch (office, south-east), the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 (table, north-east corner) and the safe in the north-east hallway office. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item — and you do not need to kill anyone. If you miss one during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a while, so you can come back for the rest; it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check it under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). Only possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between the two. Raise strength by working out — buy a fitness club membership and always bring your partner along (hold Right + Triangle to call them): while one of you trains, the other finishes their training automatically, so you progress twice as fast. Find clubs on the map under Activities (dumbbell icon); you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Do 500 things that move your criminal profile. Turn on the notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) — a little demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever your reputation shifts, and the trophy list itself shows your count out of 500. Profiles run from Professional (stealthy jobs, destroying evidence, clean getaways) through Hardened (wounding without killing) and Violent (killing enemies and civilians) to Psycho (mass killing, driving over gravestones) — and Irredeemable, which is permanent if you keep the violence up. Almost every robbery and fight counts, so this should land on its own while you chase everything else; if it does not, running over civilians and cops with a car farms it fast — just know cops shoot on sight more at Psycho or Irredeemable.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has a proven method yet. PowerPyx's current belief is that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific way; the store is in Little Cuba, Vice City. Do not chase this one on a guess — check PowerPyx's guide for updates before spending time on it.
trophies.source2: eGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies And Achievements

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and come alone. It is a random spawn: sometimes a blinking car sits at the roadside, sometimes not — if it is not there, drive away and come back. When the car is there, follow the path from it into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Walk up to it and it drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it somewhere crowded, like Vice City or Ocean Beach, where the pedestrians are thick on the ground.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is a running total across all robberies, not one delivery. It comes naturally with the 100% robberies, and a single bank vault can hand you up to $205,000 once those unlock after Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is….

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. The game has 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 11 tattoo studios, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 15 electronics stores and 19 Pay 'n' Sprays — buy what you actually want and the total climbs on its own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are 4 more story garages, but they do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages open for purchase after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) — you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app is on your phone, and you buy the garages through it. Robberies are the quickest money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app lands on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses) — it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. First you need parking space: buy garages (see Little Boxes), since each garage adds spots. Then drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, choose Respray and Register. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
